summary: Centerra Gold filed a 6-K disclosing TSX acceptance of a renewed normal course issuer bid (Canada's buyback program) plus a new $75 million working capital facility for its Langeloth metallurgical site. The NCIB permits repurchases of up to 19,318,076 common shares — 10% of public float — from November 10, 2026 to November 9, 2027, with daily purchases capped at 167,484 shares (25% of average daily volume). Of 193,671,809 shares outstanding, 8,970,800 were bought under the prior bid at a C$24.33 VWAP. Watch actual buyback pace and the OSC's expanded U.S.-venue flexibility.
